title: An Egyptian company that farms, packs and exports its own fish
p1: AZAFCO International farms, processes, packs and exports fresh fish for commercial buyers, with a packing capacity of up to 2,500 tonnes a month.
p2: Since 2008 we have shipped fresh chilled fish to importers, distributors and foodservice buyers; today we pack at our plant in Motobas, Kafr El Sheikh.
imageAlt: Aerial view of earthen fish ponds with aerators and palms in the Nile Delta at golden hour
